Samir: FYI bringing up community model x-lingua-7b, HF import dropped tokenizer.json; we only got tokenizer_config.json and vocab files. fast-tokenizer load throws a KeyError on 'special_tokens_map'.
Maya: ugh, seen this when HF repos only commit tokenizer_config.json + merges.txt. fast relies on tokenizer.json for serialized state. slow tokenizer loads but token ids mismatch in tests.
Devon: can you paste the exact error/log? also which hf-converter script did you run?
Samir: error: `KeyError: 'special_tokens_map'` when instantiating PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained(repo)
Samir: run log: ```
> transformers-cli convert --model_name_or_path ./repo --save_tokenizer
Converting tokenizer... skipping tokenizer.json (not found)
Saving tokenizer_config.json
```
Chloe: that converter path skips writing tokenizer.json if tokenizer attrs are inferred, and we sometimes rely on tokenizer.json to preserve `added_tokens` ordering and `chat_template` metadata.
Maya: quick repro: `PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained('./repo')` will try to load tokenizer.json > tokenizer_config.json. If tokenizer.json missing, it tries to build from vocab + merges which can change indices.
Devon: and our fast/slow parity checks at onboarding compare decode(tokenize(text)) roundtrip; mismatch flagged as regression.

onboarding-bot: New model import "x-lingua-7b" registered (id: mdl_412), status: import_failed -> tokenizer_mismatch
Samir: for a quick workaround I regenerated tokenizer.json locally using `tokenizers` builder and wrote `tokenizer.json` into repo; fast loader happy and evals proceed. Command I used:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')  # built from training snapshot
# or rebuilt from tokenizer_object and then
t.save('tokenizer.json')
```
Maya: could also modify importer: when tokenizer.json missing, synthesize it from tokenizer_config + vocab + merges and copy `special_tokens_map` from tokenizer_config if present. But need to be careful with added tokens and offsets.
Chloe: another angle: our chat_template fields often live in `tokenizer_config.json` under `model_max_length` or `chat_template` custom key; fast loader ignores extra keys. That causes downstream conversation formatting tests to fail.
Devon: Proposed short-term: update HF import job to 1) detect missing tokenizer.json 2) attempt synthesize with best-effort (copy specials, preserve added_tokens as order from config) 3) run our fast-vs-slow roundtrip check; if mismatch, mark as manual review.
Samir: +1. Also add a debug artifact to import (dump the synthesized tokenizer.json and a small parity diff). Saves time for SEs.
Maya: long-term: improve converter to always emit tokenizer.json in canonical form when converting HF repos. File should include `special_tokens_map`, `added_tokens`, `normalizer` and `pre_tokenizer` sections.
Chloe: noted. I'll open a small PR on the importer with a fallback synthesizer and the parity check. Assigning to @Maya for tests.
Devon: tagging docs/bringup checklist: add step "verify tokenizer.json present or synthesize" and include commands to reproduce.
Samir: thanks. Saving failing model to sandbox: s3://redwood-onboarding/mdl_412/ for manual inspection.
Maya: thanks — will follow up with PR link and a few unit tests that simulate missing tokenizer.json + chat_template preservation. :thumbsup:
Chloe: good plan. if anyone hits this in the wild, ping me and i'll run the quick regen script.
Samir: closing loop later with eval diffs, will post summary here when done.
